# PalTrade

> Forex analysis platform with beginner classes, strategy backtesting, and an AI trading mentor.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of PalTrade with live-style market ticker, beginner classes, and the AI mentor chat.
- [Backtest](/backtest): Test forex strategies (SMA crossover, RSI reversal) on historical price data with performance stats.
- [Brokers](/brokers): Connect trading accounts from Deriv and Vantage.
